description: This file defines the Sugar_Smarty class, a wrapper extending the Smarty templating engine for use within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It manages Smarty configuration, plugin registration, template loading, and error handling.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A specialized subclass of Smarty tailored for the SugarCRM SuiteCRM environment. It initializes directories, registers plugins, manages theme-based template paths, and overrides certain methods for error handling and template loading.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Smarty directories, registers plugins, and configures template, cache, and config directories for the SugarCRM environment.

methods.name: registerPHPFunctions
methods.description: Registers a list of PHP functions as Smarty plugins if not already registered.

methods.name: _unlink
methods.description: Overrides the _unlink method to avoid errors if the cache file does not exist.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Loads and fetches a template, injecting global variables like language strings and configuration into the template context.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays a template after resolving its path.

methods.name: get_template_vars
methods.description: Retrieves template variables, aliasing the Smarty getTemplateVars method.

methods.name: load_filter
methods.description: Loads a specified filter by type and name.

methods.name: _get_compile_path
methods.description: Generates the filename for a compiled template based on resource name.

methods.name: _get_auto_filename
methods.description: Creates a safe filename for auto-generated files based on source and ID.

methods.name: _get_plugin_filepath
methods.description: Assembles the file path for a plugin based on its type and name.

methods.name: smarty_core_assemble_plugin_filepath
methods.description: Searches plugin directories for the plugin PHP file and caches the result.

methods.name: clear_compiled_tpl
methods.description: Clears the cached compilation of a template.

methods.name: trigger_error
methods.description: Logs Smarty-related errors at various severity levels.

methods.name: loadTemplatePath
methods.description: Attempts to load a theme-specific template path; falls back to default if not found.
